h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thiruvananthapuram

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thiruvananthapuram

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Thiruvananthapuram

c: Thiruvananthapuram gets rain from two monsoons, and the sea is never far away, so outdoor equipment here faces damp, salty air for most of the year. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Thiruvananthapuram for IT and office campuses, government offices, colleges, schools, residential associations and city parks. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 1,290 km away, and we send every order to Kerala by road.

The capital has a large population of government staff and IT employees who walk and jog in the early morning. An open gym near a walking path or within an office campus gives them strength work as part of that habit. Our Fun Fitness machines need no electricity and no trainer. We plan the layout from your photos, and our team or a dealer in south India installs it once you approve.

richText.heading: An outdoor fitness corner for an office campus

c: On an IT or office campus, the gym is used in short breaks and before or after shifts. Machines that give a full workout in a few minutes are best. The

Kerala's rain is heavy from June and again from October, so a covered or tree-shaded spot is useful. Galvanised frames and moulded parts handle the wet, but campuses near the coast should rinse salt off the frames now and then. A drained, rubber-floored base keeps footing firm. items.q: Can an office campus in Thiruvananthapuram set up an outdoor gym for staff?
items.a: Yes. A set of four to eight stations near a walking path or the canteen gets regular use. Share the available space and number of staff, and we will suggest a layout.

items.q: How do the machines handle Kerala's two monsoons?
items.a: The frames are galvanised and the seats and handles are roto-moulded, so they resist rust in long wet spells. Keep the base drained and wipe moving parts after heavy rain.
Yes. We deliver by road from our Vasai factory and install with our team or a dealer in the southern region, using grouted or self-standing bases as the ground allows.
